prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 93.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 89.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 38.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Personality Wheel Friend Picker: Redesign the friend selection screen into a dynamic quadrant wheel spotlight showing trait previews, animation samples, and audio voice clips. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate among main steps (74.4%) with a long median decision time of 89s.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Account Sync Reorder: Move sign-in to take place immediately after adoption certificate confirmation, securing pet configuration to the account before generation starts. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in, and securing identity after certificate creation reduces post-adoption drop-off.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Account Desktop Sync Conflict Warning: Display an explicit hint on the sign-in screen warning users to sign into their original account to prevent profile overwrites or missing pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns lost or reset pets when signing in again on desktop.)
3: [home, wait_info] Live GPU Hardware Diagnostics Waiting Badge: Display active system rendering status and hardware acceleration badges on the waiting screen during generation. (why: Home stage mean time is 2336s and 3 support tickets reported app stalls or pets failing to display on screen.)
4: [adoption, copy] Custom Creation Quality Safety Guarantee Copy: Add clear copy on photo upload assuring users that lighting auto-enhancement and manual retouching options safeguard custom pet creation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output during adoption.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Taskbar Tray Spawn Notification Prompt: Add a system tray ready notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted immediately when their pet appears on desktop. (why: Users take median 201s waiting for rendering, and support reports reveal uncertainty around initial pet desktop spawn.)
6: [finish, layout] Interactive Docked Controls Banner Layout: Update the home intro screen to a full bleed layout showcasing visual shortcut banners for desktop controls, pet summoning, and tray settings. (why: The finish step drops to 69.7% completion and 3 support tickets report post-onboarding confusion on how to hide or talk to the pet.)
